newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spicer says Asia units ahead of target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spicer says Asia units ahead of target.

text.p: Paper merchant Spicers Paper Ltd said on Friday its recently acquired businesses in Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong were running slightly ahead of their profit targets after three months of operations under the group.

"Overall, we are happy with the way progress has developed and, as I said, after having owned the businesses for three months, they are slightly in front of their profit plan and one can't ask for more than that," managing director Peter Hammond told reporters after the annual general meeting.
Spicers bought the three paper distribution businesses from Singapore-based Inno-Pacific Holdings Ltd for A$63 million, effective from July 1.
The three now trade under the Spicers name.
Hammond described the Hong Kong business as an exciting exposure to the Chinese market, but said Spicers was not yet looking at the entering the mainland domestic market.
"I would want to be absolutely sure of that market until we plunged into it. We are not in the business of taking unnecessary risks," he said.
